## Type of change

- [ ] `feat` — new user-visible feature
- [ ] `fix` — bug fix
- [ ] `refactor` — behaviour-preserving code change
- [ ] `test` — adding or updating tests
- [ ] `style` — CSS / formatting only
- [ ] `ci` — pipeline changes
- [ ] `docs` — documentation only
- [ ] `chore` — deps, tooling, config

## Checklist

- [ ] Commit messages follow the [Conventional Commits](../CONTRIBUTING.md#commit-convention) format
- [ ] `npm run ci:local` passes locally (typecheck → lint → test → build → size → E2E)
- [ ] UI changed → visual baselines regenerated with `npm run e2e:visual:update` and committed
- [ ] New public behaviour documented (README / JSDoc) where relevant
